counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Yuan Shu (Huai country, Anhui and Jiangsu, 191-199)

problems: MODEL CHOICE needing the orchestrator: han-dynasty now draws, from 196 to 220, Cliopatria's Cao Cao shapes (197, 207, 215) as the Han realm (the land governed from Xuchang), so it covers the same land as the cao-cao dossier (ea-03, not yet on the mount) from 197. The compiler must draw one; recommended: the Han (its succession to Cao Wei is the realm's own), with cao-cao as events only. If ea-03 keeps cao-cao as a drawn state, either mark the overlap or undo the 187-196 losses and the 207/211 gains together.

Cross-dossier mismatches of 1 to 3 years and of counterpart name remain: sun-ce gains Zhejiang from the Han in 197 and Jiangxi in 199 (han-dynasty 196); yuan-shao gains Bing in 199 (196 here); han-sui gains Guanzhong in 197 (196 here); the warlord dossiers hand land to cao-cao in 204-215 where han-dynasty records gains from yuan-shao (207) and han-sui (211). The Han ledger also carries a loss to liang-province-rebels in 187 (their gain 187) and gongsun-liaodong 190, champa 192, liu-zhang 188, liu-biao 190, yuan-shao 191, gongsun-zan 193, zhang-lu 194, sun-ce 195 that match those dossiers' years.

Lelang 23-44 now matches goguryeo (32 contest, 37 loss, 44 gain), lelang-commandery and wang-tiao (25 loss, 30 gain). Hami 119 and 126 match xiongnu (the xiongnu dossier still lacks the 77 gain and 89 loss that the Han side carries). The Henan and Lelang cells given to the Gengshi Han in 23 (confidence 1) have no matching loss in xin-dynasty (its 14-22 keyframe holds Korea and Henan; its 23 shape does not).

xin-dynasty (verdict thin) was edited only where the chimei finding names it (ledger 4 and 6, wars/1/zones): the Chimei region is now southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu (Linyi 150 km and Xuzhou 100 km discs within the cells the Xin held in 14 and not in 23, 432 cells). The gap-filler for xin-dynasty should re-read the file before changing it.

Disagreements recorded in the notes: Hami loss dated 119 (not 107); the Lâm Ấp page does not say the Han lost control in 192 and does not call Xianglin the south of Rinan; Xianglin lies outside Cliopatria's Han shapes, so no keyframe changes; Liaodong 190 (page: 189).
